title: Industrial Carbon Management Summit 2026
summary: Annual Brussels summit of Europe's industrial carbon management community on 3 December 2026 (08:30–18:00), under the theme "Setting the conditions for scale". It covers policies, market frameworks and investment conditions as European CCS projects move toward large-scale deployment.
why_it_matters: EU market-framework and investment discussions shape the regulatory and commercial conditions for cross-border CO2 flows from Nordic-Baltic emitters to North Sea storage.
